title: Petition of Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company for authority to issue and sell notes in the aggregate principal amount of up to $2,000,000 to facilitate issuance of New Hampshire pollution control revenue bonds; to execute a loan agreement with the industrial Development Authority of the State of New Hampshire and to utilize a bank letter of credit or other credit enhancements including municipal bonds issuance to support such bonds, if necessary.
petitioner: Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company d/b/a Unitil
